title: Unexampled
summary: UNEXAM'PLED, adjective Having no example or similar case; having no precedent; unprecedented; unparalleled; as the unexampled love and sufferings of our Savior.

inlines.v: UNEXAM'PLED, adjective Having no example or similar case; having no precedent; unprecedented; unparalleled; as the unexampled love and sufferings of our Savior.
